reviews.title: Not worth the money.
reviews.text:
If you’re a Baltimore Ravens fan living outside of Maryland, NFL+ is simply not worth the money, especially if you already pay for cable.

My biggest frustration is the misleading way games are advertised. The NFL app will indicate that a game is available to watch, but when you actually try to stream it, you’re told you must wait 24–48 hours after the game ends to watch the full replay. What exactly are we paying for if we can’t watch our favorite teams live?

Now let’s talk about NFL RedZone. As a Ravens fan, you would think RedZone would at least provide a reasonable opportunity to follow your team’s biggest plays. Unfortunately, that hasn’t been my experience. I’ve repeatedly noticed the Ravens receiving significantly less coverage while other teams are consistently prioritized. I believe there’s a clear bias in how coverage is distributed, and I’m willing to back that criticism up with examples.

The bigger issue is that the NFL has become increasingly disconnected from the very fans who made it successful. Between expensive subscriptions, regional broadcasting restrictions, and fragmented streaming services, watching your favorite football team has become unnecessarily complicated and expensive.

It’s 2026. There is absolutely no reason an American football fan living anywhere in the United States shouldn’t be able to watch their favorite NFL team play live without jumping through hoops or paying for multiple subscriptions.

The NFL needs to stop treating loyal fans lik

Literally yesterday it made me sign in to my account, and then today it made me do it again. It’s unbelievably aggravating, as it’s the most basic thing an app should be able to do. On top of that, there’s 5 different providers/subscriptions that you need to be signed in to in order to get access to certain games (paramount, prime, etc.) and this stupid app can’t bother to keep me signed in to those either! So every couple of days, I have to once again sign in to 5 different subscriptions. My Apple TV is the most recent model, I’ve tried deleting and reinstalling the app, but it doesn’t matter, this app will make you sign in to your various accounts over and over and over again. Ridiculous!

reviews.title: Second year in a row this app doesn’t work
reviews.text:
I have subscribed to NFL + premium, and for the second year in a row, this app didn’t function. During week 1, the app wouldn’t stream my NFL Sunday Ticket games, even though my account is linked. Redzone didn’t work for the first game window, but then did for the second game window. Now this week, my logged in TV provider game won’t stream, but Sunday Ticket and Red Zone are working just fine. This is pathetic. I did all the trouble shooting, and same garbage happened last season, and the app didn’t work properly until several weeks into the season. Now we’re into week two with the same trash this season. And NFL customer service is so overwhelmed with other problems and complaints that they can’t respond in real time and have to email customers later. I think all NFL + premium subscribers deserve a refund. If you have to delete and reinstall the app constantly, the app doesn’t work. Also, if I can’t watch all my games in one place, like advertised, when I pay for it, then I deserve my money back. This isn’t a one off issue. This is a systemic failure of the app.

Week 3 update: everything is now working—except local market broadcast game on Fox not streaming through provider, even though I’m logged in through my provider. Still a pathetic excuse for an app. 

Also, still no response from NFL customer service or tech support. I deserve a partial refund at this point at the very least. It shouldn’t take 3 weeks to get 90% of the app functioning. It should have been 100% funct

reviews.title: The NFL stands for No Fan Love. Parasitic Thieves!!!! 🧟‍♂️
reviews.text: The NFL app is a complete rip off. They make sure you cannot watch your team play. Even after paying an egregious amount for NFL+ and premium services. The subscriptions over promise and under deliver on NFL viewership. It also leaves you still needing 4 more apps to watch your team play this season. The app violates my privacy, tracks me and takes sensitive metadata that I should not have to allow you access to so I can watch football! The app is also super annoying. I had to remove the app to reset the settings and remove my favorite team to prevent game updates and info on my teams game showing on my cell phone, since I have to watch the highlights later since I cannot watch the game on my NFL app. This app is exactly what is wrong with the world today. You have completely ruined the NFL experience to be able to steal another $100 from me. I am already paying for my team’s stadium, being subject to an overwhelming amount of advertising, and the suckofication of the viewer experience is being made even worse with the daunting subscription requirements to watch the game on a different service provider every week. The NFL is run by evil, greedy, worthless parasites we would all be better off if they never existed.

reviews.title: This app is absolutely malfunctioning
reviews.text: So I recently renewed my subscription to NFL plus so that I can watch via my mobile phone. I initially had issues with doing that through the NFL app so I did it instead from the App Store with success. After completing those steps, I went back to the NFL app and clicked on the NFL Redzone to watch that and at first I was able to get through to set up the beginning countdown to NFL Redzone but then at exactly 1 PM Eastern standard time I got nothing but a blank screen, and then a total shut down! I then closed the app and reopened it to get back to NFL Redzone, but when I initially got back on to the app, it gave me a message of unable to show something. I forget the exact words, but it was unable to show and it told me to try again later, and I pushed the OK button to check back out and it checked me back out, but then it gave me that same message up, unable to complete and it gave me the OK button once again, and that same thing continued and continued and continued to happen and it would not allow me to actually shut down the app until I used VoiceOver settings to open up a new app and shut the NFL app behind that other app! I hope that these issues get fixed sooner rather than later, but until I noticed that things have been fixed, I will not be turning on that app for the near future because I’m afraid that there may be some sort of viruses or something going on with that app

reviews.text:
I use this last couple years. Was able to watch Redzone on my TV with the app or my phone.
Randomly, in the middle of the season, they changed their user agreement so that you could no longer watch the red zone on your TV. They didn’t tell the subscribers this. reviews.title: This App is TERRIBLE
reviews.text: The first thing I want to say is that I use this app a lot and when it works, it’s awesome. I frequently watch replays every week as it provides a great way to watch games with NFL+ if you can’t watch them live. However, every single week there is some issue with using this app. Last week the issue was that my team’s game just wasn’t playable when using the replay option. I’d click on it and it would just sit there with a black screen and error out. Other games were available and working just fine. Other weeks skipping through commercials is spotty as the game will just freeze. There have been times in the past where the game will be in the first quarter and then when skipping through commercials the game just jumps to the middle of the 4th quarter. Some issue with the upload or something. Issue after issue after issue. Here’s the thing. I get that apps have issues, nothing is perfect, but this is the NFL. They are made of money and it is unacceptable to have this many issues and bugs from an organization this big. This app is honestly amazing, when it works. It is just infuriating how unreliable it is. It is CONSTANT with bugs. I expect more NFL, especially when I’m paying this much money. Do whatever you need to do to make it more reliable.

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text: Several years ago this was a great app. Then it turned into a cash grab when they pushed NFL+ and put a lot of content behind a paywall. That was annoying but somewhat understandable. I could still get a bit of decent content. Then came the barrage of ads for every single video. A 6 second highlight video has a 30 second video. For a while that was tolerable because you could watch several videos after that ad. Then came the switch to ads preceding every single clip. Annoying sure, but there were still some articles that were worth reading. The quality of the articles went downhill pretty quickly though. Most of the articles just turned into a long list of tweets that were compiled to make some semblance of an “article”. But there were still some good things being reported- Bucky Brooks had some great pieces still (among others). Then came the latest update a few days ago and the app hasn’t opened properly since. I have switched to The Score for my NFL news and deleting this one. Really a big shame since I used to love spending time getting lost on this site.

reviews.title: Buyer beware
reviews.text: Let me just say, when this app works like it is designed to, it is a thing a beauty. However, be cautious of other reviews stating that they have issues accessing NFL+ premium. Each week, the NFL app says that I need to subscribe to the  annual or monthly plan for NFL+ premium when I already have. When the restore purchases button doesn’t work (it never does) you are stuck trying to contact customer service. This is where the real issue is that will drive you crazy. There is no live customer service that can help you. Your main options are a chat bot, virtual phone agent (basically a chat bot you talk to), and a form that can be filled out and reviewed by the customer service team. How in the world does a multi billion dollar company not have this simple issue fixed (I have read of others having similar issues in previous years) or not have a single live person who can help me with an issue that seems to happen every week I watch football. If you are getting the app for all other things like scores, replays, etc. it’s a great app. I would just be cautious if you are like me and enjoy the benefits that come with NFL+ premium because there is a good chance you won’t have access to it each it week if you paid for it. Save yourself the headache until they finally listen to customers and fix the app.

reviews.title: App should bypass regional blackouts!
reviews.text: I’m tired of the shameless, greedy geriatrics who run the NFL. Why do they remain tethered to the technologies that will die with the Boomers? I ONLY WANT TO WATCH MY TEAM’S GAMES! It shouldn’t matter where I live. That’s the whole reason for me spending $15/months for NFL+. These regional blackouts make no sense. If I only wanted to watch the local team play, I’d drop $100 for a TV antenna and be done. It’s bad enough that I’m forced to watch the games on a phone or tablet, but blocking out games is the final straw. Greedy Luddites of the NFL, please give me what I want at a price I can afford. Quit catering to affluent Boomers with your Direct TV packages. Until then I’ll either stream illegally or stop watching. For $15/month I should be able to watch my team’s games on ANY screen I wish. I already need to endure the awful commercials so I shouldn’t pay more than that. (I’d pay $20/month if I could just have a camera left on the field during commercials.) Charging hundreds of dollars for season only prevents families from having access and it reduces the likeliness of future fans. Stop being greedy and shortsighted!
